name: HostGator
tagline: cPanel shared hosting with unmetered bandwidth and a 30-day guarantee
description: HostGator is a long-running web host offering cPanel-based shared, WordPress, VPS and dedicated hosting, with unmetered bandwidth, a free first-year domain, and a 30-day money-back guarantee.
about: HostGator's shared hosting lineup has three main tiers: Hatchling (10GB SSD storage, up to 10 websites), Baby (20GB SSD storage, up to 20 websites) and Business (50GB SSD storage, up to 50 websites), with a higher Pro tier (100GB SSD storage, up to 100 websites) above that. All plans run on cPanel, include unmetered bandwidth, a free SSL certificate via Let's Encrypt, and a free domain for the first year when purchased on a 12, 24 or 36-month term.

The lowest advertised prices require the longest (36-month) upfront term and only apply to the first invoice. On that term, Hatchling starts at $3.75/month but renews at $10.99/month, Baby starts at $4.50/month and renews at $16.49/month, and Business starts at $6.25/month and renews at $21.99/month — increases of roughly 150-190%. Shorter terms and month-to-month billing carry higher rates throughout. Check the live renewal price for your exact term length before buying on the lowest headline number alone.
policies: HostGator backs its hosting plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee; domain registration fees and other add-ons are excluded from the refund.

faqs.a: Yes — every HostGator shared, WordPress, VPS and dedicated plan runs on the industry-standard cPanel control panel.

faqs.q: What does HostGator's shared hosting renew at after the intro term?
faqs.a: On a 36-month term, Hatchling renews at $10.99/month (up from a $3.75/month intro rate), Baby renews at $16.49/month (from $4.50), and Business renews at $21.99/month (from $6.25). The promotional rate only applies to your first invoice.

faqs.q: Does HostGator include a free domain?
faqs.a: Yes, HostGator includes a free domain for the first year on 12-month, 24-month or 36-month shared hosting terms.

faqs.q: What is HostGator's money-back guarantee window?
faqs.a: 30 days from purchase for hosting fees. Domain registration charges and other add-on services are non-refundable.

faqs.q: Does HostGator include a free SSL certificate?
faqs.a: Yes — every HostGator plan includes a free SSL certificate so your site is secured over HTTPS from day one.

faqs.q: Do I need a promo code to get HostGator's best price?
faqs.a: Not always — some HostGator deals apply automatically at checkout, while others require pasting a revealed code into the promo/coupon field before you pay. Check each listing above for details.

faqs.q: How do I get started with HostGator?
faqs.a: Pick a plan that fits your needs on HostGator's website, complete checkout, and your account is usually ready within minutes.

faqs.q: Is HostGator good value for hosting?
faqs.a: HostGator is one of the more popular hosting providers — compare its plans and any current deal above against your specific needs before committing.

faqs.q: Can I cancel my HostGator plan anytime?
faqs.a: Most HostGator plans can be cancelled from your account dashboard; check HostGator's own terms for any minimum-term or refund conditions that apply to your plan.

faqs.q: How often are HostGator deals updated?
faqs.a: Our team checks HostGator's offers regularly and updates this page when new deals go live or old ones expire.
